results.id: L|summary
results.detail: Unit 1 states the package handles records of pre-customers (gen_precustomer = 1). That is true for 4 of the 5 data flows, but the active flow 'By Pre Account Number' has NO gen_precustomer filter (DTSX:6008), so it also processes records of non-pre-customers. Rest of unit 1 (four link paths, status 3 on match, status 8 only in two flows, empty update/3 in the other two) checked against DTSX:9944/10002/9850/main.cs, 8313/8376/8156, 3179/3154/3126, 6008/6160/6193 and is correct. Unit 2 checked: [CRM] and [qsql] both psql/ALTSHULER_MSCRM (DTSX:6,11), [CRM] is referenced by no component (only DTSX:4), every source/lookup uses [qsql], no SQL DML, all writes CrmProxy+ExecuteMultipleExtension RequestType.Update, CRM2015.Proxy reference, ServerName/OrganizationName from gen_etlvariable (DTSX:2304), no DTS:Configuration.
results.evidence: DTSX:6008-6018 (source SQL without gen_precustomer); DTSX:4-16; DTSX:2304

results.id: L|finding#1
results.detail: Program: Derived 'Set Status To Wrong' sets 8 (DTSX:10002), split gen_status == 8 (DTSX:9850), script WRONG = 4 and checks Row.genstatus == WRONG (main.cs:34,137), Union All Input 2 carries no Gen_programmainId/gen_customername so they are NULL, gen_calculatescore -> FINISH 3 (main.cs:151-152), else an Entity with only Id is added and sent. AJ: same pattern (DTSX:3154, 3126; STATUS_WRONG = 4 main.cs:32,72; main.cs:86-87). Customer Account (STATUS_NO_ACCOUNT = 8, main.cs:34,136) and Pre Account Number (STATUS_NO_ACCOUNT = 8, main.cs:29,55) are consistent. Record left in 1/2 is re-selected by the 1/2 filter next run.

results.id: L|finding#2
results.detail: Technical facts verified: all four active writers add ExecuteMultiple faults to ErrorBuffer and no PATH leaves any writer (--list output); CastingError outputs (Program, Customer Account, AJ) are unconnected (Pre Account Number has no CastingError; its row exceptions go to ErrorBuffer, main.cs:75-79); the final ExcecuteBulk() in Input0_ProcessInput is outside try/catch (e.g. Program main.cs:203-212) so an exception there fails the component and the data flow, blocking the Success constraint to the next task; a failure inside the per-row try skips myEntities.Clear() and Count == 500 is never hit again. The final consequence is overstated: 'such a request exceeds the usual ExecuteMultiple size limit and is expected to fail the package' is stated unconditionally, but whether the accumulated batch exceeds the limit depends on how many rows follow the failed batch (data-dependent; the 500 stuck entities plus fewer than ~500 later rows stay within the commonly cited 1000-request default), and the external proxy behaviour is unknown.
results.evidence: Program main.cs:160-213 (DTSX:10133); Customer Account main.cs:168-221; AJ main.cs:91-144; Pre Account Number main.cs:69-117

wrongUnits.problem: Runtime consequence (oversized ExecuteMultiple, package failure) stated as certain although it depends on row volume and on the unsupplied CRM2015.Proxy.
wrongUnits.correct: If an ExcecuteBulk call fails mid-stream, all later rows accumulate with the 500 un-cleared entities and are sent as one ExecuteMultiple at end of rowset; if that batch exceeds the server's ExecuteMultiple limit (general CRM knowledge, ExecuteMultipleExtension not supplied) the final call throws outside try/catch and fails the data flow.

results.id: L|Package\Link Pre Meet The Customer To Customer Program|detailed
results.detail: Population, lookup, branches and writes match DTSX:9944, 9872, 10002, 9850 and main.cs:129-213. Two problems: (1) unit 2 says the meaning of producttypecode 200004 is unknown, but the supplied files label it: 0028_Fund Enrolment selects producttypecode = '200004' AS GeneralPension (0028:6918-6920) and 0031_PoaAccountUpdateDaily tags ProductTypeCode = 200004 with '--clalit' next to gen_includinggeneralpension (0031:7627). (2) Missing: unlike the Customer Account flow, this source has no 'gen_precustomeridnumber is not null' filter (DTSX:9944) and the lookup is full cache (CacheType 0, DTSX:9880); a record with NULL ID therefore can match a Gen_programmain whose gen_customeridnumber is NULL (full-cache NULL=NULL matching, general SSIS behaviour) and be linked to that program — the analyst flags this exact mechanism for the Customer Account flow but omits it here.

wrongUnits.correct: Supplied files label 200004 as General Pension (פנסיה כללית): alias GeneralPension in 0028 and comment --clalit with gen_includinggeneralpension in 0031 (label-level evidence, cross-package).

Source does not exclude NULL gen_precustomeridnumber; with a full-cache lookup a NULL ID can match a program with NULL gen_customeridnumber (general SSIS behaviour), so such a record would be linked to that program (and contact) and, with a score, set to 3.
